verdicts.reason: A turns the layout into a clean side-by-side banner: the skull and yellow bar sit on the left and the quote wraps naturally on the right with an attribution below it. Its flaws are small: the bar's right end almost touches the start of the text, and the skull's jaw crowds the bottom edge. B keeps the original's forced line breaks, so 'fellow' and 'help' are left alone on their own lines and the text block looks jagged. Its quote is also cramped against the top edge and the attribution is squeezed against the last line, which is broken typography.
